hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook integrating Euler Finance lending vaults as liquidity reserves. In beforeSwap, it computes a quote against a configurable invariant curve (EulerSwap v1), deposits input tokens into the corresponding Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from the other vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully handle pool accounting — bypassing Uniswap's native CLAMM pricing entirely.
